title: 第13章 豪门千金（13）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    西礼堂偏向欧式风格，场地却不是很大，能收到请帖的，那都是全国五百强中的，这些人中也不是都在这个大学念书，许多都选择出了国。

    所以来的人也没多少，加上各自带来的同伴和一些学生会的，不足百人。

    时笙没有男伴，就一个人站在角落，看着场中那些形形色色的人，他们脸上带着一层面具，谁也不知道那层面具下是什么样的表情。

    可是作为旁观者，就能轻易的捕捉到，他们会在对方不注意的时候露出厌恶，鄙夷，嫉妒，羡慕之类的情绪。

    “你看什么这么开心？”清丽的女声在时笙耳畔响起。

    肖薇穿着紧身的礼服，将凹凸有致的曲线完美的勾勒出来，画着精致的妆容，一头波浪卷，举手投足都透着风情无限的魅力，御姐范十足。

    时笙看了她一眼，觉得挺无聊的，索性和肖薇聊天，“你不觉得他们很好玩儿吗？”

    “哪里好玩？”

    “整天带着面具，你说他们累不累？”

    肖薇愣了下，像是看怪物一般的看着时笙，见她依旧兴致勃勃的盯着场中的人，肖薇发现自己忽然有些看不懂面前的女生了。

    她和许乘月虽然不是很熟，但是因为她是南宫景的未婚妻，她没少收集她的资料，可资料上的那个许乘月，和面前这个女生，明显有些不一样。

    许乘月骄傲，是被娇养出来的公主，和所有的豪门千金差不多。

    但是面前这个女生，带着一股说不出的感觉，非要让她形容的话，应该是——恶意。

    对所有人都存在的恶意。

    这特么是要报社啊？

    肖薇被这个想法吓一跳，在看旁边的女生，依旧笑眯眯的，像只看到好玩玩具兴趣十足的猫，哪里有半点危害？肖薇觉得自己想多了，赶紧将那个念头甩开。

    “一会儿有场好戏，你要加入看戏小分队吗？”时笙突然朝着肖薇发出邀请。

    肖薇压下刚才那诡异的感觉，恢复了风情万种的御姐范，眼带不屑，“什么好戏？”

    这个女人在搞什么？

    “保证不让你失望。”

    时笙完全是看在肖薇是个悲惨女配，挺倒霉的份上，才邀请她的。

    肖薇思索了下，微微颔首，她倒要看看许乘月在搞什么鬼。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The west auditorium is in European style, but the venue is not very big. Those who can receive invitations are all among the top 500 in the country. Not all of these people are studying in this university, and many have chosen to go abroad.

So there weren’t many people who came. Including the companions they brought and some from the student union, there were less than a hundred people.

Shi Sheng had no male companion, so he stood alone in the corner, looking at the various people in the field. They wore masks on their faces, and no one knew what kind of expressions they had under that mask.

But as a bystander, you can easily catch them showing emotions such as disgust, contempt, jealousy, and envy when the other person is not paying attention.

"What makes you so happy?" A clear female voice sounded in Shi Sheng's ears.

Wearing a tight-fitting dress, Xiao Wei perfectly outlines her curves. She has exquisite makeup, her hair is wavy, and her every move exudes infinite charm. She is full of royal-sister style.

Shi Sheng glanced at her and found her quite boring, so he simply chatted with Xiao Wei, "Don't you think they are fun?"

"Where is the fun?"

"Wearing a mask all day long, do you think they are tired?"

Xiao Wei was stunned for a moment, looking at Shi Sheng like a monster. Seeing that she was still staring at the people in the field with interest, Xiao Wei found that she suddenly couldn't understand the girl in front of her.

Although she didn’t know Xu Chengyue very well, because she was Nangong Jing’s fiancée, she collected information about her. However, the Xu Chengyue in the information was obviously different from the girl in front of her.

Xu Chengyue is proud. She is a pampered princess, similar to all the wealthy daughters.

But the girl in front of her had an indescribable feeling. If she had to describe it, it would be - malice.

There is ill will towards everyone.

这特么是要报社啊？

Xiao Wei was startled by this idea. She looked at the girl next to her, still smiling, like a cat who was only interested in seeing a fun toy. How could there be any harm in it?Xiao Wei felt that she was thinking too much and quickly shook that thought away.

"There will be a good show soon, do you want to join the theater team?" Shi Sheng suddenly extended an invitation to Xiao Wei.

Xiao Wei suppressed the weird feeling just now and returned to her charming royal sister style, with disdain in her eyes, "What's the show?"

What is this woman doing?

“I promise I won’t let you down.”

Shi Sheng only invited Xiao Wei because she was a miserable supporting actress and quite unlucky.

Xiao Wei thought for a moment and nodded slightly. She wanted to see what Xu Chengyue was up to.
